note: The engine release this desktop version is paired with. It is unpinned: no engine release carrying Linux packages exists yet, so nothing is claimed. To pin it, take the engine tag whose release publishes fermix_<version>_<amd64|arm64>.deb and fermix-<version>-1.<x86_64|aarch64>.rpm and change, all together: tag (vX.Y.Z), source_commit (the 40-character commit that tag was built from), certificate_identity (https://github.com/tezra-io/fermix/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/ plus the tag), and each package's asset and sha256 (the digest in the asset's .sha256 sidecar). Either every one of those is null or every one is filled: scripts/engine_pin.sh refuses a half-filled pin, which is the dangerous state because it reads as a pin to a glance and names an engine nothing can verify. The pinned version is also this desktop package's own version, because fermix-desktop declares Depends: fermix (= <version>) and Requires: fermix = <version>, and both packages of a version become visible together.
